base: round-7 head lineage, backbone frozen, T=0.46 baked kept; round-8d recipe + mined look-alike hard negatives + adversarial ring synth + blur robustness

gate._comment: Two different gates exist by design; the dashboard HTML is authoritative at runtime.

training_strict_gate.where: offline selection metric only (bench strict pass, OOD rejection training eval); stricter than tier-1 on purpose

known_limitations: 6-class closed-world head: tomato look-alike diseases (septoria leaf spot ~26/31, bacterial spot ~31/39, target spot ~27/36, leaf mold ~27/38 mined images) still pass tier-1; round-9 cut the mined leakage 30% (224->157) but eliminating it requires a class-set redesign, not fine-tuning.
Synthetic flat-green cards with drawn necrotic rings: round-9 withholds ~22/30 fresh ring cards, but a perfectly drawn low-noise ring card can still pass.
Blur robustness is now a strength (75/75 real scans tier-1 correct up to 3.0 px Gaussian), but extreme defocus (>3px) remains untested territory.
Agronomic safety for off-target crops beyond the 6 classes relies on OE withholding plus the physical shroud.
